capability_extensions.formal_admission_bridge: Schema2.0.0 binds v3 plan/readiness/result artifact receipts and replays six v3 judge bundles; unsupported native inventory, nested usage, quality and preflight/controller replay remain explicit blockers. No formal promotion.

capability_extensions.research_followup_mechanism: Opt-in v3 task packs bind admitted followups and trusted history, seven closest-work query families, resource checks and no-progress stopping; task generation does not prove native completion.
capability_extensions.source_context_native_calibration: Blinded no-tool native supplemental 12-case runner; input/runtime/shared-code bindings, per-attempt evidence, external receipted completed-unit resume, explicit incomplete reviewer; native QA does not establish formal admission.
capability_extensions.native_trace_file_integrity: Bounded raw native trace byte reader authenticates caller-retained inventory receipt; file identity, traversal/reparse, file count and finite-read guards. Offline observation primitive; no execution or formal promotion.
capability_extensions.native_trace_inference_parsing: Receipt-reader-dependent private inference helpers resolve tool definitions and same-thread deltas; typed token subsets and complete compaction accounting remain explicit. Parsing cannot attest execution or formal readiness.
capability_extensions.named_native_capture: Opt-in capture v2 binds exact restrictive named permission config, native managed network proxy and protected role directories; reconstructs dispatch without overriding named permissions with legacy sandbox arguments. Functional preflight and role isolation remain separately required.
capability_extensions.native_compaction_accounting: Private per-request compaction accounting binds native request/response payloads and distinct retry identities. Duplicate terminals are idempotent only when identical; missing native token usage remains unknown and overlapping inference identity cannot establish complete totals.
capability_extensions.native_trace_observation: Offline receipt-bound native event inspector links inferences, offered tools, child edges, failures and token totals. Missing terminals and unaccounted compaction stay explicit blockers; this is content observation, not execution attestation or formal admission.
capability_extensions.native_seal_io_anchors: Retained directory handles anchor regular-file reads and exclusive seal writes; pathname replacement cannot redirect writes. This primitive has no execution or formal admission authority.
capability_extensions.native_observation_io: Producer-supplied retained directory handles anchor every metadata/failure write with exclusive leaves; legacy collector remains compatible. No model dispatch, isolation proof or formal promotion.
capability_extensions.native_observation_deadlines: Schema2.0.0 records an explicit finite metadata RPC deadline; legacy1.0.0 remains replayable. Invalid limits fail before output/RPC. Timeouts remain partial; a longer deadline is not evidence of successful inventory or formal readiness.
capability_extensions.native_observation_response_bounds: Binary bounded readline supports large valid private metadata frames while enforcing64MiB frame/128MiB stream ceilings; finite distinct JSON, UTF8, reader and limit failures remain non-formal. No native feature or permission reduction.
capability_extensions.native_producer_public_replay: Strict read-only frozen-request/external-receipt replay projects verified attempted model/tool/child counts separately from unknown token usage and partial API metadata. Synthetic producers reject; no environment mutation, dispatch or formal promotion.
capability_extensions.native_trace_capture_seal: Opt-in immutable capture/trace content seal binds verified native capture identity, every raw trace byte and recomputed observation; bounded no-follow reads and checked resume preserve synthetic markers and unknowns. Content linkage does not attest genuine acquisition or formal readiness.
capability_extensions.native_trace_producer: Named-policy host wrapper binds one native capture, pre-turn API inventory and immutable raw-trace sealing; receipt-verified resume never re-executes. Host observation is not provider attestation or formal admission.
capability_extensions.source_context_native_replay: Read-only current-format verifier rebuilds supplemental 12-case/24-judgment native requests, replays every original/correction archive, binds display sidecars and recomputes outcomes; attempted root calls exclude nested inference inventory, cost stays unknown and formal-ready false.
capability_extensions.native_judge_worker: One frozen role-owned prompt/schema calls unchanged native v3.1 capture; strict read-only replay binds raw generations, display copies, complete archive inventory and worker/runtime bytes. Host semantic checks, namespace attestation, nested usage, calibration and formal admission remain separate.
capability_extensions.role_policy_controller_contract: Opt-in controller1.1 resolves SHA-bound named policy1.1 per home/workspace; denied capture_root contains every fresh output; both observed restricted filesystem representations and active profile must match. Legacy contracts remain separate; no formal isolation or quality promotion.
capability_extensions.assessment_target_policy_contract: Opt-in3.1 prompt framing scores the actual submitted content, not external facts or the judge's critique; each criterion and temporal version remains separate. Legacy producers/replay and v3 rubric stay unchanged. Host bindings pin actual policy bytes; no native admission, formal readiness or quality claim is inferred.
capability_extensions.native_judge_trace_replay: Strict original-seal replay joins every native judge attempt root to its exact trace, recomputes offered tools and usage, rejects missing/foreign/tampered evidence, and dispatches no model. Namespace isolation and scientific/formal acceptance remain external.
capability_extensions.daily_assessment_target_policy: Explicit opt-in3.1 framing binds actual submitted-content policy bytes before independent native daily scoring; request/config/result/resume reflect the choice. Legacy prompt/field semantics remain unchanged, actual code-byte changes still invalidate prior runtime bindings. No formal promotion.
